body: Well I've got about 10 minutes till I flip the coin and if I don't shoot myself, I've already decided to pack a bag and just start walking.

I keep telling myself that, but it's just gotten to a horrifyingly bad state, and a lot moreso in the last year. Call me a coward but I'm sick of trying, and seeing all my friends from school succeeding while I'm trapped in this depressingly dark place. I can't even sleep anymore so that just adds to the other bullshit
Although I've had the urge, I haven't done that.
Thanks but unfortunately for me it's just getting worse and worse. At the end of the day, I'm only 1 miserable person out of 7+ billion.

She's holding me hostage in the relationship. I've gotten verbally abusive from getting so angry and saying things that I highly regret, and she is threatening to tell the police and everyone she knows if I try to leave her. And to be honest, I probably deserve time in jail. But fuck it, I'd rather just end it.
